records.title: Bachelor's and Master's Scholarships in Finland (university-offered; no national government scholarship programme)
records.deadline_display: With some universities, you can apply for a scholarship at the same time as you submit your admission application

source.as_of: Page states "Updated 04.06.2026"; no application cycle named
source.raw_extract: How to apply for a scholarship — Scholarships and tuition fee waivers in Finland are offered by individual universities. There are no governmental scholarship programmes available. ... With some universities, you can apply for a scholarship at the same time as you submit your admission application — making it easy to plan your studies and funding together. In other cases, scholarships may become available after you've started your studies. These can, for example, reward your progress, academic success, or even your growing Finnish language skills. ... You can typically find instructions for applying for a scholarship alongside the application information.
source.exact_deadline_wording: With some universities, you can apply for a scholarship at the same time as you submit your admission application
source.notes: No calendar deadline is published on this official page, and none is derivable: the page explicitly assigns both the existence and the timing of every scholarship to the individual university ("offered by individual universities", "You can typically find instructions for applying for a scholarship alongside the application information"). There is no single deadline that belongs to this record. The record's existing precision "varies" is a fair description of reality, but the contract reserves precision "varies" for CONFLICTING (two credible sources disagreeing about the same deadline), and no such disagreement exists here, so semantics/precision are recorded as UNKNOWN/unknown. The "same time as your admission application" sentence is a routing rule, not a date, and was not used to infer one.

records.title: Finland Scholarship (National Programme for Master's Students)

source.publisher: Study in Finland, published by the Finnish National Agency for Education
source.as_of: News item dated 02.12.2025 on the official Study in Finland site
source.raw_extract: Scholarships for studies in Finland - facts! ... Heard about fully funded Finnish government scholarships? Be cautious - those claims are misleading. While Finland doesn't offer any governmental study scholarships, some universities do provide their own tuition fee waivers. ... That's because it is not true. ... The truth is, there are no governmental scholarships for bachelor's or master's studies in Finland. ... Individual Finnish universities may offer scholarships - Some individual Finnish universities have scholarships of their own for international students admitted to their fee-charging bachelor's and master's, for example in the form of tuition fee waivers.
source.notes: Record premise refuted by the official source of record. This record names a national Finnish government scholarship programme for Master's students, but the Finnish National Agency for Education states on its official site that no such programme exists and warns that advertising one is misleading. There is therefore no official page that states any deadline for this title, and no deadline can be recovered without inventing one; nothing was written. Outcome is 'rejected' (the record cannot be substantiated as an existing programme) while deadline_semantics remains UNKNOWN, since no source describes any deadline for this title. The record is already flagged verification_status=quarantined in the shard. deadline_display and exact_deadline_wording are null because no provider wording about timing exists.
